Europe Endures Heatwave with Rising Deaths and Wildfire Fears

A severe heatwave has gripped parts of Europe, including Italy, the Balkans, and other regions, leading to a significant increase in excess deaths. Countries are grappling with the impact, with concerns rising about wildfires. In India, Delhi-NCR is also experiencing heatwave conditions, with reports of AC malfunctions and a surge in hotel bookings.
